topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: When I opened my door today, there on the mat were these vibrant tulips, their petals dancing in the light breeze that had found its way in. No note, no card, just the delicate beauty of nature arranged with such care. I couldn’t help but wonder who might have sent such a thoughtful gift. Picking them up, I took a moment to appreciate the effort and mystery behind this surprise. The colors were so inviting, and the gesture, so unexpected, that I felt a warm sense of connection, as if someone was reaching out to me with a silent, heartfelt wish. I placed them in a vase by the window, where they now sit, bringing a splash of color and a soft smile to my day.
